rule: Every parameter-evidence row must reference existing canonical source_card_id values
notes: Multi-source fields may use semicolon-separated canonical IDs only after those IDs exist in the source-card register.

rule: Research memos are discovery aids and cannot be primary sources
notes: Discovery provenance may mention memo paths but primary evidence must be the underlying public source.

rule: Conversation-local turn references cannot be the sole stable source locator
notes: A turn reference may remain in discovery notes only when a stable URL DOI identifier or page locator is also present.

rule: Incomplete source locators block development-input review
notes: Rows with locator_complete=false may remain discovery-only or pending review.

rule: Source metadata and parameter values must remain separate
notes: Source cards may list relevance and locators but candidate values belong in the parameter-evidence register.

rule: Candidate parameter-evidence rows cannot be executable
notes: Executable values require later governed approved-input promotion.

rule: Approved-input tables are separate from candidate-evidence registers
notes: The status vocabulary may mention approved_model_input but candidate rows must not use it as an active status.

rule: Validation targets cannot become operating inputs
notes: Validation evidence may guide plausibility checks but cannot silently drive constraints or objectives.

rule: Confidential or redacted values cannot become exact public model truth
notes: Such evidence may support category awareness or blocked status only.

rule: Duplicate DOI or formal document identifiers are blocked
notes: Alternative download URLs are not separate sources when the underlying document is the same edition.

rule: Exact duplicate parameter-evidence keys are blocked
notes: Corroborating evidence from different sources must follow the duplicate-key policy rather than duplicate the same row.
